records.statement:
theorem error_eq_initial_mul_exp_integral {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma : ℝ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    e t = e 0 * Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, g s))
records.proof:
by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => g (max s 0)
  have hq : Continuous q := hg.comp_continuous
    (continuous_id.max continuous_const) (fun s => le_max_right s 0)
  have hqe (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) : q s = g s := by
    simp only [q, max_eq_left hs]
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ v in 0..s, q v
  have hG (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt G (q s) s :=
    (hq.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => e s * Real.exp (gamma * G s)
  have hw (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ)) : HasDerivAt w 0 s := by
    convert (hd s hs).mul ((hG s).const_mul gamma).exp using 1
    rw [hqe s hs]
    ring
  have hc : ContinuousOn w (Ici (0 : ℝ)) :=
    fun s hs => (hw s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hanti : AntitoneOn w (Ici (0 : ℝ)) :=
    antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ)) hc
      (fun s hs => (hw s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun _ _ => le_refl 0)
  have hmono : MonotoneOn w (Ici (0 : ℝ)) :=
    monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ)) hc
      (fun s hs => (hw s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun _ _ => le_refl 0)
  have hconst : w t = w 0 := le_antisymm
    (hanti (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 0 by simp) ht ht)
    (hmono (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 0 by simp) ht ht)
  have hvalue : e t * Real.exp (gamma * G t) = e 0 := by
    simpa only [w, G, intervalIntegral.integral_same, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] using hconst
  have hGt : G t = ∫ s in 0..t, g s := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht] at hs
    exact hqe s hs.1
  have he : e t = e 0 / Real.exp (gamma * G t) :=
    (eq_div_iff (Real.exp_ne_zero _)).2 hvalue
  rw [he, hGt]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_mul]
records.comment:
The exact integrating-factor formula only needs continuity of the actual
coefficient on nonnegative time.  No positivity of the damping is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem error_pos {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma : ℝ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e t * g t) t)
    (he0 : 0 < e 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 < e t
records.proof:
by
  rw [error_eq_initial_mul_exp_integral hg hd ht]
  exact mul_pos he0 (Real.exp_pos _)
records.comment: A positive initial scalar gap cannot become zero at a finite time.

records.proof:
by
  intro t ht
  have hx : ContinuousAt x t := (htraj t ht).1.continuousAt
  have hy : ContinuousAt y t := (htraj t ht).2.continuousAt
  have hxy : ContinuousAt (fun s => (x s, y s)) t := hx.prodMk hy
  exact ((continuous_gSq lam r u).continuousAt.comp hxy).continuousWithinAt
records.comment:
The coefficient in the energy law is continuous along the actual curve;
no continuity of b is needed once both actual coordinate derivatives exist.

records.statement:
theorem energy_gap_exact {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target =
      (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) *
        Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, gSq lam r u (x s) (y s)))
records.proof:
by
  exact error_eq_initial_mul_exp_integral (continuousOn_gradient_coefficient htraj)
    (fun s hs => hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory htraj hs) ht
records.comment:
Exact gap evolution along a supplied trajectory, with its actual gradient
coefficient inside the integral.

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_target_iff {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    E lam r u (x t) (y t) = target ↔ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) = target
records.proof:
by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, energy_gap_exact htraj ht, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [Real.exp_ne_zero, or_false, sub_eq_zero]
records.comment:
Reaching the target at a finite time is equivalent to starting there.
Thus the strict-gap hypothesis in the no-return results is substantive.

records.statement:
theorem energy_strictly_above_target {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target < E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : target < E lam r u (x t) (y t)
records.proof:
by
  have hpos := error_pos (continuousOn_gradient_coefficient htraj)
    (fun s hs => hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory htraj hs) (sub_pos.mpr hinit) ht
  exact sub_pos.mp hpos
records.comment:
Strict separation from the target is preserved at every finite time.
Unlike strict decay, this conclusion needs no sign assumption on gamma.

records.statement:
theorem energy_deriv_neg {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target < E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    deriv (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s)) t < 0
records.proof:
by
  have he := energy_strictly_above_target htraj hinit ht
  have hg := gSq_pos_on_band hlam htarget he.le
  have hd := hasDerivAt_energy_fixed_input lam r u gamma target (b t)
    (htraj t ht).1 (htraj t ht).2
  rw [hd.deriv]
  have hpos := mul_pos (mul_pos hgamma (sub_pos.mpr he)) hg
  nlinarith
records.comment:
Above all critical values the actual energy derivative is strictly
negative along a trajectory starting strictly above its target.

records.statement:
theorem energy_strictAntiOn {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target < E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) :
    StrictAntiOn (fun t => E lam r u (x t) (y t)) (Ici (0 : ℝ))
records.proof:
by
  apply strictAntiOn_of_deriv_neg (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))
  · intro t ht
    exact (hasDerivAt_energy_fixed_input lam r u gamma target (b t)
      (htraj t ht).1 (htraj t ht).2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    exact energy_deriv_neg hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit (interior_subset ht)
records.comment: The actual energy is strictly antitone on the entire nonnegative time axis.

records.statement:
theorem trajectory_injOn {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target < E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) :
    InjOn (fun t => (x t, y t)) (Ici (0 : ℝ))
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs t ht heq
  have hxs : x s = x t := congrArg Prod.fst heq
  have hys : y s = y t := congrArg Prod.snd heq
  have hE : E lam r u (x s) (y s) = E lam r u (x t) (y t) := by rw [hxs, hys]
  exact (energy_strictAntiOn hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit).injOn hs ht hE
records.comment: No two distinct nonnegative times visit the same spatial state.

records.statement:
theorem trajectory_no_return {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target < E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))
    {s T : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (x (s + T), y (s + T)) ≠ (x s, y s)
records.proof:
by
  intro heq
  have h := trajectory_injOn hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit
    (add_nonneg hs hT.le) hs heq
  linarith
records.comment: In particular, no spatial return occurs after a strictly positive time.

records.statement:
theorem trajectory_not_periodic {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target < E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    ¬ Function.Periodic (fun t => (x t, y t)) T
records.proof:
by
  intro hp
  exact trajectory_no_return hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit (le_refl 0) hT (hp 0)
records.comment: A positive finite period is impossible under the same strict initial gap.

records.statement:
theorem error_eq_initial_mul_exp_integral_on_Icc {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma T : ℝ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e s * g s) s)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    e t = e 0 * Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, g s))
records.proof:
by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => g (max 0 (min s T))
  have hq : Continuous q := hg.comp_continuous
    (continuous_const.max (continuous_id.min continuous_const))
    (fun s => ⟨le_max_left 0 (min s T), max_le hT (min_le_right s T)⟩)
  have hqe (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : q s = g s := by
    simp only [q, min_eq_left hs.2, max_eq_right hs.1]
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ v in 0..s, q v
  have hG (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt G (q s) s :=
    (hq.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => e s * Real.exp (gamma * G s)
  have hw (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : HasDerivAt w 0 s := by
    convert (hd s hs).mul ((hG s).const_mul gamma).exp using 1
    rw [hqe s hs]
    ring
  have hc : ContinuousOn w (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    fun s hs => (hw s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hanti : AntitoneOn w (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) T) hc
      (fun s hs => (hw s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun _ _ => le_refl 0)
  have hmono : MonotoneOn w (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) T) hc
      (fun s hs => (hw s (interior_subset hs)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun _ _ => le_refl 0)
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨le_refl 0, hT⟩
  have hconst : w t = w 0 :=
    le_antisymm (hanti hzero ht ht.1) (hmono hzero ht ht.1)
  have hvalue : e t * Real.exp (gamma * G t) = e 0 := by
    simpa only [w, G, intervalIntegral.integral_same, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] using hconst
  have hGt : G t = ∫ s in 0..t, g s := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hs
    exact hqe s ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
  have he : e t = e 0 / Real.exp (gamma * G t) :=
    (eq_div_iff (Real.exp_ne_zero _)).2 hvalue
  rw [he, hGt]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_mul]
records.comment:
A local version of the exact scalar formula uses only data on a finite
closed interval.  It is suitable for an actually constructed local solution.

records.statement:
theorem energy_gap_exact_on_Icc {lam r u gamma target T : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hode : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      HasDerivAt x
        (-gamma * (E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target) * gx lam r u (x s) (y s)
          - b s * gy (x s) (y s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt y
        (-gamma * (E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target) * gy (x s) (y s)
          + b s * gx lam r u (x s) (y s)) s)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target =
      (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) *
        Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, gSq lam r u (x s) (y s)))
records.proof:
by
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun s => gSq lam r u (x s) (y s)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    intro s hs
    have hxy : ContinuousAt (fun v => (x v, y v)) s :=
      (hode s hs).1.continuousAt.prodMk (hode s hs).2.continuousAt
    exact ((continuous_gSq lam r u).continuousAt.comp hxy).continuousWithinAt
  apply error_eq_initial_mul_exp_integral_on_Icc hg hT ?_ ht
  intro s hs
  exact (hasDerivAt_energy_fixed_input lam r u gamma target (b s)
    (hode s hs).1 (hode s hs).2).sub_const target
records.comment:
Exact energy evolution on a finite interval follows from coordinate ODEs
on that interval alone; no global trajectory premise is required.

records.statement:
theorem reduced_energy_bound {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (r x : ℝ) :
    -3 * lam * x ^ 4 / 4 - r * x ^ 2 / 2 ≤ (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
records.proof:
by
  have h := LinearInputCalculus.critical_value_le
    (r := r) (u := lam * x ^ 3 + r * x) (x := x) hlam rfl
  rw [LinearInputCalculus.critical_value rfl] at h
  exact h
records.comment:
The quartic remainder in the energy-gradient identity has the same bound
as the already proved critical values, without a stationarity assumption.

records.statement:
theorem energy_gradient_identity (lam r u x y : ℝ) :
    E lam r u x y = -3 * lam * x ^ 4 / 4 - r * x ^ 2 / 2 +
      x * gx lam r u x y + Real.sqrt 2 * x * gy x y + (gy x y) ^ 2 / 2
records.proof:
by
  unfold E f gx gy
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  ring
records.comment: Energy is its bounded quartic remainder plus an actual-gradient term.

records.statement:
theorem gradient_linear_term_sq (x a b : ℝ) :
    (x * a + Real.sqrt 2 * x * b) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * x ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
records.proof:
by
  have hi : 3 * x ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) -
      (x * a + Real.sqrt 2 * x * b) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 * a - b) ^ 2 := by
    ring_nf
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    ring
  have hn : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 * a - b) ^ 2 := by positivity
  linarith
records.comment: The exact two-dimensional Cauchy estimate uses sqrt(2)^2 = 2.

records.proof:
by
  have hd : 0 < target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) := sub_pos.mpr htarget
  have hS : 0 ≤ max (upper + lowerBoundConstant lam r u) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  unfold gradientLowerBound
  exact div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hd) (by positivity)

records.statement:
theorem explicit_gradient_bound {lam r u target upper x y : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (hlo : target ≤ E lam r u x y) (hhi : E lam r u x y ≤ upper) :
    gradientLowerBound lam r u target upper ≤ gSq lam r u x y
records.proof:
by
  let delta := target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)
  let S := max (upper + lowerBoundConstant lam r u) 0
  let g := gSq lam r u x y
  let L := x * gx lam r u x y + Real.sqrt 2 * x * gy x y
  have hd : 0 < delta := sub_pos.mpr htarget
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := le_max_right _ _
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := gSq_nonneg lam r u x y
  have hx : x ^ 2 ≤ S := by
    have hc := coercive_lower_bound hlam r u x y
    have hs : upper + lowerBoundConstant lam r u ≤ S := le_max_left _ _
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - Real.sqrt 2 * x)]
  have he : delta ≤ L + g / 2 := by
    have hi := energy_gradient_identity lam r u x y
    have hb := reduced_energy_bound hlam r x
    have hgy : (gy x y) ^ 2 ≤ g := by
      dsimp [g, gSq]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gx lam r u x y)]
    dsimp only [delta, L]
    linarith
  have hL : L ^ 2 ≤ 3 * S * g := by
    have hc := gradient_linear_term_sq x (gx lam r u x y) (gy x y)
    change L ^ 2 ≤ 3 * x ^ 2 * g at hc
    have hm := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx) hg
    nlinarith
  have hy : 2 * delta * L ≤ delta ^ 2 + 3 * S * g := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (L - delta)]
  have hm : delta ^ 2 ≤ (3 * S + delta) * g := by
    have he' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * delta)
    nlinarith
  change delta ^ 2 / (3 * S + delta) ≤ g
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 3 * S + delta)).2
  nlinarith
records.comment: A fully explicit lower bound for the squared actual gradient on the band.

records.statement:
theorem gradient_bound_of_initial {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ),
      gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) ≤
        gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)
records.proof:
by
  intro t ht
  have hb := energy_band_of_trajectory hgamma htraj hinit t ht
  exact explicit_gradient_bound hlam htarget hb.1 hb.2
records.comment:
The computed band constant applies for all nonnegative times, with band
invariance derived from the initial condition and actual trajectory equations.

records.statement:
theorem energy_error_exponential_of_initial {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target ∧
      E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target ≤
        (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) * Real.exp
          (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))) * t)
records.proof:
by
  have hband := energy_band_of_trajectory hgamma htraj hinit
  have hg := gradient_bound_of_initial hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit
  refine ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr (hband t ht).1, ?_⟩
  apply LinearInputDissipation.exponential_bound
    (v := fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target)
    (q := fun s => -gamma * (E lam r u (x s) (y s) - target) *
      gSq lam r u (x s) (y s))
    (k := gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)))
  · intro s hs
    exact hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory htraj hs
  · intro s hs
    have hn := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hgamma (sub_nonneg.mpr (hband s hs).1))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hg s hs))
    nlinarith
  · exact ht
records.comment:
Explicit exponential decay of the energy error itself, not only its square.
No global trajectory existence is asserted.

records.statement:
theorem squared_error_exponential_of_initial {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    {x y b : ℝ → ℝ} (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) ^ 2 ≤
      (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0) - target) ^ 2 * Real.exp
        (-(2 * gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))) * t)
records.proof:
by
  exact LinearInputDissipation.squared_error_exponential hgamma
    (fun _ hs => hasDerivAt_gap_of_trajectory htraj hs)
    (gradient_bound_of_initial hlam hgamma htarget htraj hinit) ht
records.comment: The same explicit positive constant gives the square-error estimate.

records.statement:
theorem square_bound {θ f : ℝ → ℝ} {κ ρ M : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt θ (-κ * θ t + ρ * f t) t)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), |f t| ≤ M)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (θ t)^2 ≤ (θ 0)^2 * exp (-κ*t) + (ρ*M/κ)^2 * (1-exp (-κ*t))
records.proof:
by
  let C : ℝ := (ρ*M/κ)^2
  have hC : κ^2 * C = ρ^2 * M^2 := by
    dsimp [C]
    field_simp
  have hv : ∀ s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (θ s)^2-C) (2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s)) s := by
    intro s hs
    convert ((hd s hs).pow 2).sub_const C using 1; ring
  have hi : ∀ s ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
      2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s) ≤ -κ*((θ s)^2-C) := by
    intro s hs
    have hf2 : (f s)^2 ≤ M^2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_abs (f s), hf s hs, abs_nonneg (f s)]
    have hforce : ρ^2*(f s)^2 ≤ ρ^2*M^2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf2 (sq_nonneg ρ)
    have hscaled : κ*(2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s)+κ*((θ s)^2-C)) ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (κ*θ s-ρ*f s)]
    have hsum : 2*θ s*(-κ*θ s+ρ*f s)+κ*((θ s)^2-C) ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hb := LinearInputDissipation.exponential_bound hv hi ht
  dsimp [C] at *
  nlinarith

supplied internal coordinate.

records.statement:
theorem square_le_max {θ f : ℝ → ℝ} {κ ρ M : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt θ (-κ * θ t + ρ * f t) t)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), |f t| ≤ M)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (θ t)^2 ≤ max ((θ 0)^2) ((ρ*M/κ)^2)
records.proof:
by
  have hb := square_bound hκ hM hd hf ht
  have he0 : 0 ≤ exp (-κ*t) := (exp_pos _).le
  have he1 : exp (-κ*t) ≤ 1 := exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (le_max_left ((θ 0)^2) ((ρ*M/κ)^2)) he0
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (le_max_right ((θ 0)^2) ((ρ*M/κ)^2)) (sub_nonneg.mpr he1)
  nlinarith
records.comment: Uniform square bound, including the initial transient.

records.statement:
theorem exists_forcing_bound {lam r u gamma target : ℝ} {x y b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))
    {Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hΦ : Continuous Φ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), |Φ (x t,y t)| ≤ M

by
  have hcompact := LinearInputCoercivity.isCompact_band hlam r u target
    (E lam r u (x 0) (y 0))
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hcompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hΦ.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have hz := LinearInputInvariance.energy_band_of_trajectory hgamma htraj hinit t ht
  have hb := hC (x t,y t) hz
  exact (show |Φ (x t,y t)| ≤ C by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb).trans
    (le_max_left _ _)
records.comment:

supplied trajectory, using its derived compact energy confinement.

theorem internal_update_bounded {lam r u gamma target κ ρ : ℝ}
    {x y b θ : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (htraj : IsTrajectory lam r u gamma target x y b)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (x 0) (y 0)) (hΦ : Continuous Φ)

records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hf⟩ := exists_forcing_bound hlam hgamma htraj hinit hΦ
  refine ⟨max ((θ 0)^2) ((ρ*M/κ)^2), (sq_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩

continuous observable of a confined supplied spatial trajectory.

theorem exists_local_solution {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)

    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z t₀ = z₀ ∧ ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ),

records.statement:
theorem local_solution_unique {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    {lam r u gamma target t₀ : ℝ} {z w : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hz : IsIntegralCurveAt z (fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b) t₀)
    (hw : IsIntegralCurveAt w (fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b) t₀)
    (heq : z t₀ = w t₀) : z =ᶠ[𝓝 t₀] w
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hlip⟩ :=
    (contDiff_vectorField hb lam r u gamma target).contDiffAt
      (x := z t₀) |>.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  have hzs : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, z t ∈ s := hz.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hs
  have hws : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 t₀, w t ∈ s := hw.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (heq ▸ hs)
  exact ODE_solution_unique_of_eventually (v := fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b)
    (s := fun _ => s) (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => hlip) (hz.and hzs) (hw.and hws) heq

records.statement:
theorem solution_unique_on_interval {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    {lam r u gamma target a c t₀ : ℝ} {z w : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Ioo a c)
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a c, HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a c, HasDerivAt w (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (w t)) t)
    (heq : z t₀ = w t₀) : EqOn z w (Ioo a c)
records.proof:
by
  let s := {t | z t = w t} ∩ Ioo a c
  suffices hsub : Ioo a c ⊆ s from fun t ht => (hsub ht).1
  apply isPreconnected_Ioo.subset_of_closure_inter_subset (s := Ioo a c) (u := s) _
    ⟨t₀, ⟨ht₀, ⟨heq, ht₀⟩⟩⟩
  · change closure ({t | z t = w t} ∩ Ioo a c) ∩ Ioo a c ⊆
      {t | z t = w t} ∩ Ioo a c
    rw [inter_comm, ← Subtype.image_preimage_val, inter_comm, ← Subtype.image_preimage_val,
      image_subset_image_iff Subtype.val_injective, preimage_ofPred_eq]
    intro t ht
    change (t : ℝ) ∈ closure (Subtype.val '' (Subtype.val ⁻¹' {t | z t = w t})) at ht
    rw [← closure_subtype] at ht
    revert ht t
    apply IsClosed.closure_subset (isClosed_eq _ _)
    · rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact (hz t ht).continuousAt.comp continuousAt_subtype_val
    · rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact (hw t ht).continuousAt.comp continuousAt_subtype_val
  · rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro t ht
    have hmem := Ioo_mem_nhds ht.2.1 ht.2.2
    have hzl : IsIntegralCurveAt z (fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b) t := by
      filter_upwards [hmem] with q hq
      exact hz q hq
    have hwl : IsIntegralCurveAt w (fun _ => vectorField lam r u gamma target b) t := by
      filter_upwards [hmem] with q hq
      exact hw q hq
    exact (local_solution_unique hb hzl hwl ht.1).and hmem
records.comment: Local uniqueness propagates over the common open interval of two actual solutions.

records.statement:
theorem exists_local_unique_solution {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (lam r u gamma target : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z t₀ = z₀ ∧

      ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, w t₀ = z₀ →

        z =ᶠ[𝓝 t₀] w

  obtain ⟨z, hz₀, ε, hε, hz⟩ := exists_local_solution hb lam r u gamma target z₀ t₀

    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith : t₀ - ε < t₀)

    exact hz t ht

  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.fst, h.snd⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩

theorem exists_local_solution_energy_formula {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b)
    (lam r u gamma target : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ T > (0 : ℝ), ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 - target =
          (E lam r u z₀.1 z₀.2 - target) *
            Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, gSq lam r u (z s).1 (z s).2))
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z, hz₀, ε, hε, hz⟩ := exists_local_solution hb lam r u gamma target z₀ 0
  have hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (ε / 2),
      HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z t)) t := by
    intro t ht
    apply hz t
    constructor
    · linarith [ht.1]
    · linarith [ht.2]
  refine ⟨ε / 2, half_pos hε, z, hz₀, hd, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have he := LinearInputStrictEnergy.energy_gap_exact_on_Icc
    (lam := lam) (r := r) (u := u) (gamma := gamma) (target := target)
    (x := fun s => (z s).1) (y := fun s => (z s).2) (b := fun s => b (z s))
    (le_of_lt (half_pos hε)) (fun s hs => ⟨(hd s hs).fst, (hd s hs).snd⟩) ht
  simpa only [hz₀] using he
records.comment:
An actually constructed solution obeys the exact energy formula on a nonzero
closed forward interval. This conclusion does not presume a global trajectory.

theorem error_band_on_Icc {e g : ℝ → ℝ} {gamma T : ℝ}
    (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt e (-gamma * e s * g s) s)
    (hgn : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ g s) (hinit : 0 ≤ e 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : 0 ≤ e t ∧ e t ≤ e 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [LinearInputStrictEnergy.error_eq_initial_mul_exp_integral_on_Icc hg hT hd ht]
  have hi : 0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..t, g s :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg ht.1 (fun s hs => hgn s ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩)
  have he : Real.exp (-gamma * (∫ s in 0..t, g s)) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
  exact ⟨mul_nonneg hinit (Real.exp_pos _).le,
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hinit).trans_eq (mul_one _)⟩
records.comment: A nonnegative coefficient preserves the initial error interval on [0,T].

records.statement:
theorem energy_band_on_Icc {lam r u gamma target T : ℝ} {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    {z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hode : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z s)) s)

    target ≤ E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ∧

by
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun s => gSq lam r u (z s).1 (z s).2) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    intro s hs
    exact ((continuous_gSq lam r u).continuousAt.comp (hode s hs).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  have h := error_band_on_Icc hgamma hT hg
    (fun s hs => (hasDerivAt_energy_of_solution (hode s hs)).sub_const target)
    (fun s _ => gSq_nonneg lam r u (z s).1 (z s).2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hinit) ht
  constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
records.comment: The actual vector ODE on a finite interval implies energy-band confinement.

records.statement:
theorem energy_band_on_Ioo {lam r u gamma target eps a : ℝ} {b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}
    {z : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} (hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hode : ∀ s ∈ Ioo (-eps) a,
      HasDerivAt z (vectorField lam r u gamma target b (z s)) s)
    (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u (z 0).1 (z 0).2)

    target ≤ E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ∧
      E lam r u (z t).1 (z t).2 ≤ E lam r u (z 0).1 (z 0).2
records.proof:
by
  apply energy_band_on_Icc (b := b) (z := z) hgamma ht (T := t) ?_ hinit ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩
  intro s hs
  exact hode s ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hs.2.trans_lt hta⟩

records.statement:
theorem exists_uniform_local_time {F : V → V} {K : Set V}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ z : ℝ → V,
      z 0 = x ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t
records.proof:
by
  classical
  have hlocal (x : V) :=
    (hF.contDiffAt (x := x)).exists_forall_mem_closedBall_exists_eq_forall_mem_Ioo_hasDerivAt 0
  choose r hr d hd hz using hlocal
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover (fun x => ball x (r x))
    (fun _ => isOpen_ball) (by
      intro x _
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, mem_ball_self (hr x)⟩)
  have hsmall : ∀ a : Finset V, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ a, ε ≤ d x := by
    intro a
    induction a using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simp⟩
    | @insert x a hxa ih =>
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, he⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨min (d x) ε, lt_min (hd x) hε, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with hxy | hya
      · subst y
        exact min_le_left _ _
      · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (he y hya)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, he⟩ := hsmall s
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hys, hxy⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hs hx)
  obtain ⟨z, hz0, hzd⟩ := hz y x (ball_subset_closedBall hxy)
  refine ⟨z, hz0, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  apply hzd t
  have hed := he y hys
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
records.comment:
Uniform local existence at every point of a compact set, obtained by a
finite subcover of the actual nearby-initial-data Picard-Lindelöf neighborhoods.

    intro t ht

    rw [← closure_subtype] at ht

      rintro ⟨t, ht⟩

    · rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      rintro ⟨t, ht⟩

theorem piecewise_eqOn {F : V → V} (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    {a b c d t₀ : ℝ} {z w : ℝ → V}
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Ioo c d, HasDerivAt w (F (w t)) t)
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Ioo a b ∩ Ioo c d) (heq : z t₀ = w t₀) :
    EqOn ((Ioo a b).piecewise z w) w (Ioo c d)
records.proof:
by
  classical
  have hu : EqOn z w (Ioo (max a c) (min b d)) :=
    unique_on_Ioo hF ⟨max_lt ht₀.1.1 ht₀.2.1, lt_min ht₀.1.2 ht₀.2.2⟩
      (fun t ht => hz t ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) ht.1,
        lt_of_lt_of_le ht.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩)
      (fun t ht => hw t ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) ht.1,
        lt_of_lt_of_le ht.2 (min_le_right _ _)⟩) heq
  intro t ht
  by_cases hmem : t ∈ Ioo a b
  · rw [piecewise, ite_eq_left hmem]
    exact hu ⟨max_lt hmem.1 ht.1, lt_min hmem.2 ht.2⟩
  · rw [piecewise, ite_eq_right hmem]
records.comment: The piecewise extension agrees with the second solution everywhere on its interval.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_piecewise {F : V → V} (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    {a b c d t₀ : ℝ} {z w : ℝ → V}
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t)
    (hw : ∀ t ∈ Ioo c d, HasDerivAt w (F (w t)) t)
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Ioo a b ∩ Ioo c d) (heq : z t₀ = w t₀) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b ∪ Ioo c d,
      HasDerivAt ((Ioo a b).piecewise z w) (F (((Ioo a b).piecewise z w) t)) t
records.proof:
by
  classical
  intro t ht
  by_cases hmem : t ∈ Ioo a b
  · have hh : (Ioo a b).piecewise z w =ᶠ[𝓝 t] z := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hmem.1 hmem.2] with s hs
      exact piecewise_eq_of_mem (Ioo a b) z w hs
    have hv := hh.eq_of_nhds
    rw [hv]
    exact (hz t hmem).congr_of_eventuallyEq hh
  · have hmem' : t ∈ Ioo c d := ht.resolve_left hmem
    have hh : (Ioo a b).piecewise z w =ᶠ[𝓝 t] w := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hmem'.1 hmem'.2] with s hs
      exact piecewise_eqOn hF hz hw ht₀ heq hs
    have hv := hh.eq_of_nhds
    rw [hv]
    exact (hw t hmem').congr_of_eventuallyEq hh
records.comment: Overlapping actual solutions glue to an actual solution on the union.

records.statement:
theorem exists_arbitrarily_long_solution
    {F : V → V} (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    {K : Set V} {z₀ : V} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ K)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hloc : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ z : ℝ → V, z 0 = x ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t)
    (hstay : ∀ (a : ℝ) (z : ℝ → V), z 0 = z₀ →
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) a, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < a → z t ∈ K) :
    ∀ a : ℝ, ∃ z : ℝ → V, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) a, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t
records.proof:
by
  classical
  let S : Set ℝ := {a | ∃ z : ℝ → V, z 0 = z₀ ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) a, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t}
  have hbase : ε ∈ S := hloc z₀ hz₀
  have hnbdd : ¬ BddAbove S := by
    intro hbdd
    let A := sSup S
    have hεA : ε ≤ A := le_csSup hbdd hbase
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hlt⟩ := Real.add_neg_lt_sSup
      (⟨ε, hbase⟩ : S.Nonempty) (ε := -(ε / 2)) (by linarith)
    change sSup S + -(ε / 2) < a at hlt
    have hta : A - ε / 2 < a := by dsimp [A]; linarith
    obtain ⟨z, hzinit, hz⟩ := ha
    have hstate : z (A - ε / 2) ∈ K :=
      hstay a z hzinit hz (A - ε / 2) (by linarith) hta
    obtain ⟨w, hwinit, hw⟩ := hloc _ hstate
    let v : ℝ → V := fun t => w (t - (A - ε / 2))
    have hvinit : v (A - ε / 2) = z (A - ε / 2) := by
      simp only [v, sub_self, hwinit]
    have hv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (A - ε / 2 - ε) (A - ε / 2 + ε),
        HasDerivAt v (F (v t)) t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht' : t - (A - ε / 2) ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε := by constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
      have hshift : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s - (A - ε / 2)) 1 t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const (A - ε / 2)
      simpa only [v, one_smul, Function.comp_def] using (hw _ ht').scomp t hshift
    let q : ℝ → V := (Ioo (-ε) a).piecewise z v
    have hqinit : q 0 = z₀ := by
      change (Ioo (-ε) a).piecewise z v 0 = z₀
      rw [piecewise, ite_eq_left (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-ε) a from ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)]
      exact hzinit
    have hq : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) (A + ε / 2), HasDerivAt q (F (q t)) t := by
      have hpatch := hasDerivAt_piecewise hF hz hv
        (t₀ := A - ε / 2)
        (show A - ε / 2 ∈ Ioo (-ε) a ∩ Ioo (A - ε / 2 - ε) (A - ε / 2 + ε)
          from ⟨⟨by linarith, hta⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩) hvinit.symm
      intro t ht
      apply hpatch t
      by_cases hta' : t < a
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ht.1, hta'⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
    have hmem : A + ε / 2 ∈ S := ⟨q, hqinit, hq⟩
    have hbound : A + ε / 2 ≤ A := le_csSup hbdd hmem
    linarith
  rw [not_bddAbove_iff] at hnbdd
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨z, hzinit, hz⟩, hac⟩ := hnbdd a
  exact ⟨z, hzinit, fun t ht => hz t ⟨ht.1, lt_trans ht.2 hac⟩⟩
records.comment: Uniform local existence on an invariant set prevents a finite forward endpoint.

records.statement:
theorem exists_forward_solution
    {F : V → V} (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    {K : Set V} {z₀ : V} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ K)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hloc : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ z : ℝ → V, z 0 = x ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t)
    (hstay : ∀ (a : ℝ) (z : ℝ → V), z 0 = z₀ →
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) a, HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < a → z t ∈ K) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → V, z 0 = z₀ ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt z (F (z t)) t
records.proof:
by
  classical
  have hall := exists_arbitrarily_long_solution hF hz₀ hε hloc hstay
  choose q hqinit hq using hall
  let z : ℝ → V := fun t => q (max t 0 + 1) t
  have hagree (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) : EqOn z (q a) (Ioo (-ε) a) := by
    intro t ht
    have hc : 0 < max t 0 + 1 := by linarith [le_max_right t (0 : ℝ)]
    have hu : EqOn (q (max t 0 + 1)) (q a) (Ioo (-ε) (min (max t 0 + 1) a)) :=
      unique_on_Ioo hF ⟨by linarith, lt_min hc ha⟩
        (fun s hs => hq _ s ⟨hs.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hs.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩)
        (fun s hs => hq _ s ⟨hs.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hs.2 (min_le_right _ _)⟩)
        ((hqinit _).trans (hqinit _).symm)
    exact hu ⟨ht.1, lt_min (by linarith [le_max_left t (0 : ℝ)]) ht.2⟩
  refine ⟨z, by dsimp [z]; exact hqinit _, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have hdom : t ∈ Ioo (-ε) (t + 1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hh : z =ᶠ[𝓝 t] q (t + 1) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hdom.1 hdom.2] with s hs
    exact hagree (t + 1) (by linarith) hs
  rw [hh.eq_of_nhds]
  exact (hq (t + 1) t hdom).congr_of_eventuallyEq hh
records.comment: Arbitrarily long compatible actual solutions give a forward-global solution.
